name: Deutschland — Lohnsteuer, Solidaritätszuschlag, Kirchensteuer und Gesamtsozialversicherungsbeitrag

changelog.summary: Statutory sick pay as a leave pay rule: six weeks of full pay (EntgFG §§ 3, 4), then unpaid as the Krankenkasse pays Krankengeld; applied where the workspace has no sick leave rule of its own. Before, sick days were paid in full unless a rule was added.

Sonstige Bezüge (BONUS: Weihnachts-/Urlaubsgeld, Prämien, 13. Gehalt) are supported: Lohnsteuer, SolZ and Kirchensteuer by the PAP's annual-wage method (§ 39b Abs. 3 EStG) on the voraussichtlicher Jahresarbeitslohn from this year's payrolls, and contributions as einmalig gezahltes Arbeitsentgelt up to the anteilige Beitragsbemessungsgrenze (§ 23a SGB IV); U1 leaves them out (§ 7 Abs. 2 AAG). The Lohnsteuer line is now recorded even at 0, so its base builds the annual wage. Before, a period with a BONUS was refused.

Corrects silent errors: U1 participation without the employee's U1 rate, and care-insurance children under 25 without the parent flag, are now refused instead of giving no U1 levy or the childless surcharge without the child reductions.

steps.message: German contributions are computed per calendar month (BVV § 1): the pay period must be a calendar month
Joining or leaving during the month (Teillohnzahlungszeitraum, anteilige Beitragsbemessungsgrenze) is not supported: employ the whole calendar month
Pre-tax deductions (Entgeltumwandlung, § 3 Nr. 63 EStG / § 1 SvEV) are not supported
Midijob (Übergangsbereich) and Minijob employment are not supported
A regular monthly wage of 2 000 EUR or less is in the Übergangsbereich (§ 20 Abs. 2 SGB IV) or below; such employment (and apprentices' low wages) is not supported
Employees with private health insurance are not supported
Old-age pensioners and employees exempt from statutory pension insurance pay other contribution groups (§ 5 Abs. 4 and § 172 SGB VI, § 243 SGB V), which this template does not support

From the Regelaltersgrenze (66 years and some months for those born from 1958, § 235 SGB VI) unemployment and pension insurance change to employer-only shares (§ 28, § 346 Abs. 3 SGB III, § 172 SGB VI); employees aged 66 or over are not supported
A Faktor (§ 39f EStG) applies only in Steuerklasse IV and not together with a Freibetrag
A Hinzurechnungsbetrag is not possible in Steuerklasse VI
The employer takes part in U1 (§ 1 AAG): set the employee's u1Rate, the U1 Umlagesatz of their Krankenkasse
Children under 25 for the care-insurance reductions (§ 55 Abs. 3 SGB XI) also prove the Elterneigenschaft: set pvParent, otherwise the childless surcharge would apply

A sonstiger Bezug is taxed in the year it is paid (§ 38a Abs. 1 Satz 3 EStG), and this period's payment date falls in another year: move the pay date into the period's year (Change pay date on the run), or pay the bonus in a period of the payment year
The Lohnsteuer on a sonstiger Bezug uses the annual Freibetrag (§ 39b Abs. 3 EStG): enter annualTaxAllowance, the Jahresfreibetrag from ELStAM, in the employee's details for this template

The Lohnsteuer on a sonstiger Bezug uses the annual Hinzurechnungsbetrag (§ 39b Abs. 3 EStG): enter annualTaxAddition, the Jahreshinzurechnungsbetrag from ELStAM, in the employee's details for this template

The employee joined this year: the voraussichtlicher Jahresarbeitslohn for the sonstiger Bezug includes earlier employers' wages (§ 39b Abs. 3 EStG). Enter priorEmployersWage from their Lohnsteuerbescheinigungen, or priorEmployersMonths without one (0 if they had no earlier employer this year)

A sonstiger Bezug needs this year's earlier pay with you (annual wage, § 39b Abs. 3 EStG; anteilige Beitragsbemessungsgrenze, § 23a SGB IV), and not every earlier month of employment this year is in a posted payroll: post the earlier runs, or set broughtForwardYear and the brought-forward figures for the months before Humano

Einmalig gezahltes Arbeitsentgelt paid from January to March above the anteilige Beitragsbemessungsgrenze belongs to last December (März-Klausel, § 23a Abs. 4 SGB IV), which this template does not support: correct the previous year's December payroll instead

leavePay.note: Six weeks of full pay (§§ 3, 4 EntgFG), then the Krankenkasse pays Krankengeld outside payroll. Not applied: no employer pay in the first four weeks of employment (§ 3 Abs. 3), and a renewed absence for the same illness counting towards the same six weeks.

limitations: Monthly wages for whole calendar months; joining or leaving mid-month and Entgeltumwandlung are refused.

Sonstige Bezüge are the BONUS earnings (Weihnachts-/Urlaubsgeld, Prämien, 13. Gehalt), paid with a period's current wage: Lohnsteuer by the annual-wage method (§ 39b Abs. 3 EStG) on the voraussichtlicher Jahresarbeitslohn = this year's posted current wages and sonstige Bezüge (or brought-forward figures) plus the current monthly wage for the rest of the year and for months at earlier employers without a Lohnsteuerbescheinigung; contributions up to the anteilige Beitragsbemessungsgrenze of the months with contributions (§ 23a SGB IV); U1 leaves them out. Refused: a payment date in another year (§ 38a Abs. 1 Satz 3 EStG), the März-Klausel (January to March above the anteilige BBG, § 23a Abs. 4), an earlier month of employment this year missing from the posted payrolls. Not supported: Entschädigungen and the Fünftelregelung (§ 34 EStG; do not pay redundancy payments as BONUS), one-off payments after leaving (§ 23a Abs. 2), Vermögensbeteiligungen. Months whose current wage paid no Lohnsteuer before version 2026.1.2 recorded no wage and are missing from the annual wage.

Beitragsgruppe 1111 (KV general rate, RV, AV, PV all statutory); Midijobs (Übergangsbereich), Minijobs, private health insurance, old-age pensioners, employees exempt from pension insurance, employees aged 66 or over (Regelaltersgrenze), Werkstudenten, apprentices below 2 000 EUR and other Personengruppen are refused or out of scope.

Voluntary KV members above the Jahresarbeitsentgeltgrenze are computed as in the Firmenzahlerverfahren (contribution withheld, employer share paid); Selbstzahler with a § 257 SGB V subsidy are not supported.
Kirchensteuer: 8 % in BY and BW, 9 % elsewhere, by the Betriebsstätte's Land, cents truncated; a Mindestkirchensteuer (where a church still levies one) and the Kappung are not applied.
Care insurance in Sachsen follows the employer's Land, taken as the place of work.
U1/U2 rates are the employee's Krankenkasse's; U1 applies when the employer takes part (§ 1 AAG).

Status LAW_DERIVED: the Lohnsteuer code is generated from the BMF's XML pseudocode and reproduced 180,000 amounts of an implementation written from the EStG text (all Steuerklassen, Kinderfreibeträge, church base, Sachsen, PV surcharge/reductions, Altersentlastungsbetrag, Frei-/Hinzurechnungsbeträge, Faktor), and 20,000 sonstige-Bezüge cases of its § 39b Abs. 3 counterpart; the BMF's own calculator interface has not been used.
